description: This is a shell script that sets up and runs a Docker-based environment for the OpenClaw project. It handles configuration, builds or pulls Docker images, manages volumes and compose files, and starts the gateway service with optional sandbox configuration.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr and exits the script with a non-zero status.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the system, exits if missing.

methods.name: run_docker_build
methods.description: Builds a Docker image with BuildKit enabled.

methods.name: is_truthy_value
methods.description: Determines if a given value is considered true.

methods.name: read_config_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from a JSON config file.

methods.name: read_env_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from an environment file.

methods.name: ensure_control_ui_allowed_origins
methods.description: Configures the allowed origins for the control UI.

methods.name: sync_gateway_mode_and_bind
methods.description: Sets the gateway mode and bind configuration.

methods.name: run_prestart_gateway
methods.description: Runs a command in a Docker compose service as a one-off execution.

methods.name: run_prestart_cli
methods.description: Runs the openclaw CLI command in a Docker container.

methods.name: run_runtime_cli
methods.description: Runs a CLI command with appropriate compose scope and dependencies.

methods.name: contains_disallowed_chars
methods.description: Checks if a string contains control characters like newline, carriage return, or tab.

methods.name: is_valid_timezone
methods.description: Validates if a timezone string corresponds to an existing timezone file.

methods.name: validate_mount_path_value
methods.description: Validates a path value for mounts, ensuring no control chars or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_named_volume
methods.description: Validates that a volume name matches allowed naming conventions.

methods.name: validate_mount_spec
methods.description: Validates the format of a mount specification.

methods.name: upsert_env
methods.description: Updates or inserts environment variables into a config file.

methods.name: write_extra_compose
methods.description: Generates additional Docker compose YAML for extra volumes and mounts.
